name: corpus_search
description: Search the frozen, sanitized Everstake corpus. Start here for company facts, history, product descriptions, and synthesis.

name: fact_number_lookup
description: Find passages containing exact company metrics, dates, percentages, amounts, legal names, addresses, or other literal values. Use when precision matters.

name: document_read
description: Read more of a canonical corpus document after search returns its document_id. Use to verify context, qualifiers, or a multi-part claim.

name: live_fetch
description: Fetch one HTTPS page from the strict Everstake-domain allowlist when a corpus fact may be stale. The server enforces robots, redirects, content type, size, and injection sanitation.

name: everstake_mcp
description: Call an allow-listed read-only tool on Everstake's own MCP. Use get_chains for live APR/fee/status, get_uptime_metrics for uptime, and staking_calculator for APY or a reward estimate. For get_chains pass arguments.network. For an APY-only lookup, call staking_calculator with amount 1 after identifying the currency. Never submit leads or mutate state.

name: submit_answer
description: Stop the tool loop and submit the grounded answer for deterministic citation validation. Abstain if evidence does not directly entail the claim.
